Generalizable takeaway saved:
For Treasury Bulletin yield-spread averages, use the printed percent yields, compute percentage-point spreads month by month, include all endpoint months in the calendar range, and average the monthly observations directly. For 1960-1969 this means 120 monthly observations, not annual averages.
